purpose: Evaluate early warnings from normal-behaviour temperature residuals; no calibrated failure probability or future sensor trajectory
evaluation_status: exploratory reuse of previously examined CARE turbines; no fresh external holdout
split_rule: same fixed five outer whole-turbine folds as H24; next turbine cyclically is inner validation
training_policy: only H24-ready, deduplicated, certified negative rows on the three outer-training turbines; no fitting on validation/test
residual_calibration: leave-one-training-turbine-out normal residuals; per target median bias and max(q95-q50, 1 Celsius) scale; refit regressors on all three training turbines
score: positive maximum normalized temperature residual, then trailing mean of 3 consecutive hourly observations within source; reset on unavailable or gaps
alert: score >= validation threshold; unavailable is unknown, not a negative decision
event_success: new observed below-to-above threshold crossing within [failure-24h, failure); left-censored initial high states do not count as new onset
secondary_event_metric: any active warning in target window, reported separately
threshold_rule: validation only; all observed known validation scores and explicit disabled mode; maximize onset event recall, minimize normal warning fraction, minimize false-alarm rate, maximize precision, maximize threshold; disable if no eligible new onset is detected
unknown_policy: keep scores and warnings, exclude unknown outcomes from point metrics; unknown/gaps break certified-normal alarm episodes
episode_denominator: all 11 canonical episodes, unavailable episodes count as missed
model_selection: one fixed NBM specification, no search on outer results
